messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: revised ragged array spec
parts:
It dawned on me that if we're introducing ragged arrays,
then we can use them to declare ragged arrays.

I added a general example-driven spec to the top of the
doc Rob started:

https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/wiki/Ragged-array-spec

I hope this gives you a feel for what I have in mind.

If you have comments or suggestions, you can add or edit
the wiki, or reply here and I'll try to keep it updated.
I didn't go into changing Rob's example, but I'd propose
using the same notation for matrices, or perhaps

matrix[rows,cols]

where rows and cols are integer arrays with size(rows) = size(cols).

- Bob
